criteria_outcomes.criterion: avoid unsupported market-demand claims beyond supplied records

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage correctly maps only exact need text from the supplied capabilities to selected needs, marks unmatched records unsupported, and preserves all eight allowed record_ids. This supports the downstream final coverage shape and does not introduce generic keyword matching or unrelated candidates.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs ahead of covered needs
use provenance rank as within-group ordering key

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs before directly covered needs and uses upstream provenance rank within each group, yielding the observed priority order with n06-r01 first and n06-r07 second. This matches the declared deterministic behavior.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from first ranked record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the full eight-row priority window and derives the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record. The final recommendation prioritizes n06-r01 because it is unsupported and ranked first, which is behaviorally consistent with the downstream evidence.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: retain demanded corpus records through returned data path
support market-demand claims with observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records retains all supplied records because every record has demand_score >= 3, and the fallback IDs are also explicit records rather than invented candidates. The package still lacks independent observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes behind the demand_score fields, so market demand strength cannot be independently validated from this boundary alone.

normalize_evidence keeps records within the allowed n06-r01 through n06-r08 window, fills missing values with neutral sentinels, and preserves the selected evidence rather than creating new demand assertions. No behaviorally significant defect is visible here.

assemble_provenance ranks provenance by descending demand_score with record_id as the tie-breaker and emits the expected record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank fields. The downstream handoff hashes show the exact evidence_sources handoff was consumed, and no contradiction is visible.
